catalog.title: Seiko
catalog.note: Hattori (服部時計店) loose-leaf dealer catalogue (腕時計総合カタログ) sent with a cover letter dated 昭和35年6月 (June 1960, scan 17): one model line per page — Lady Seiko, Seiko Solar, Sports Lady, Beauty, Purple, Lord Marvel, Goldfeather, Cronos (incl. the 高級防水 water-proof C-20), Sportsman, Crown, Laurel and Gyro Marvel. Every photo carries its real model code with jewels and case materials (e.g. LS-30 19j AGF), used as ref and code as printed. Prices are printed once per page in the top-right list (jewels × material → 円); each record's price is the list line(s) for its own jewel count and printed materials, and the full list is quoted in notes. Cases: SS stainless, EGP / AEGP gold-plated grades, FGF / AGF gold-filled grades, K18 solid gold; (SD) as printed on the Cronos 23j FGF / K18 lines. No calibers are printed. On scan 11 the C-21 and C-22 captions are double-printed with two overlapping material lines (conf medium); on scan 15 the second material of L-21 is rubbed off. Scan 0 cover, 17 cover letter, 18 back cover with Hattori branch addresses; no clocks.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops at full resolution.
